open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Amicales des Sapeurs-Pompiers (B2B Local France)
proposals.buyer_persona: French local fire station 'Amicale' presidents looking for custom, modern, non-copyright-infringing coloring books to distribute during their annual calendar campaign (Sainte-Barbe/fin d'année).
product_angles: Coloring books featuring realistic French fire trucks (FPT, VSAV, CCF) without brand logos
Customizable Canva templates for local fire station calendars
Vector mascot packs for custom station t-shirts and stickers
proposals.first_test_product: Le Grand Livre de Coloriage des Sapeurs-Pompiers (focused on French trucks/scenes, sold via KDP and direct B2B digital PDF download for local printing)

proposals.name: PSX Retro / Low-Poly Seamless Textures
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo indie game developers using Godot, Unity, or Unreal Engine, building retro 90s-style PSX horror/scifi games who need fast, cohesive, seamless textures.
product_angles: Seamless pixelated wall, metal, and floor texture packs (256x256 and 512x512)
Normal and height maps generated via GitHub Actions pipelines
proposals.first_test_product: Retro PSX Industrial Horror Texture Pack (50 seamless textures + normal maps on itch.io and Etsy)

proposals.name: Arborists & Tree Climbers (Élagueurs)
proposals.buyer_persona: Professional tree care specialists and climbers who view their high-risk job as an extreme sport and a core lifestyle identity.
product_angles: Pocket-sized rigging and knot guide cheat-sheets (KDP/PDF)
Funny SVG cutting files for car windows featuring climbing gear and ropes
Vintage blueprint/patent art prints of chainsaws and climbing harnesses
proposals.first_test_product: The Tree Climber's Knot & Rigging Pocket Reference Guide (KDP low-content pocket book)

proposals.name: Ham Radio Operators (Amateurs de Radio)
proposals.buyer_persona: Mainly older, highly technical, and passionate radio hobbyists who love logging contacts (QSOs), physical logbooks, and collecting QSL confirmation cards.
product_angles: Highly optimized physical Ham Radio Logbooks with fields for frequency, RST, and power
Customizable QSL card templates (sold as Canva or high-res print-ready PDFs)
Vintage radio patent art printable posters
proposals.first_test_product: Universal Ham Radio Logbook (KDP physical book with clean, high-contrast grid layouts)

proposals.name: Ultra-Trail & GR20 Elevation Profilers
proposals.buyer_persona: Extreme runners and long-distance hikers proud of finishing iconic routes (GR20, UTMB, PCT) wanting minimalist home decor representing their physical achievement.
product_angles: Minimalist GPX-based elevation profile vector posters (automated rendering)
Funny trail runner SVG/sticker packs focusing on altitude sickness, extreme fatigue, and gear
Dedicated trail-running training logs tracking elevation gain (D+)
proposals.first_test_product: GR20 Minimalist Elevation Profile Poster (Digital SVG/PDF pack for self-printing)

proposals.name: PLC & Automation Engineers (Programmable Logic Controllers)
proposals.buyer_persona: Industrial automation engineers who program factory machines (Siemens, Rockwell) and deal with commissioning chaos, PLC bugs, and 3:00 AM emergency calls.
product_angles: Humorous stickers/SVGs featuring ladder logic, PLC code, and commissioning disasters
Cheat-sheet pocket notebooks with Modbus registers and industrial networking protocols
Mug designs with 'I survived the factory floor commissioning' schematics
proposals.first_test_product: The PLC Engineer's Commissioning Survival Mug & Sticker SVG Bundle
